# Hermey

> A native iOS and macOS client for your own Hermes agent, plus the one command that installs its
> host-side bridge. No account, no cloud in the middle: the apps talk to a loopback FastAPI service on
> the user's own machine, exposed over their tailnet with a real certificate.

The repo is a client, not a server. Installation is: run one shell command as root on the Hermes host,
then install the app on a phone or Mac and pair it with a short code.

## Install

- Host (root, on a machine already running Hermes):
  `curl -fsSL https://github.com/macblizzard/hermey/releases/latest/download/install.sh | sudo bash`
- Then: `hermey pair` — prints a code, a `hermes://pair?...` deep link and a QR.
- iOS: add `https://github.com/macblizzard/hermey/releases/latest/download/altstore.json` to
  AltStore or SideStore.
- macOS: `Hermey-macOS-unsigned.zip` from the latest release; right-click → Open on first launch.

## Agent runbook

- [docs/FOR-AGENTS.md](docs/FOR-AGENTS.md): the installation procedure written for an agent to
  execute — preflight, install, verification gates, pairing, hard rules, failure playbook.

## Reference

- [docs/INSTALL.md](docs/INSTALL.md): installer flags, environment variables, paths on disk, uninstall.
- [docs/APPS.md](docs/APPS.md): iOS and macOS installation, first run, unpairing and revocation.
- [docs/TROUBLESHOOTING.md](docs/TROUBLESHOOTING.md): symptom, cause, fix, with real log strings.
- [docs/ARCHITECTURE.md](docs/ARCHITECTURE.md): how the bridge adapts the Hermes dashboard; WS protocol.

- [setup/SKILL.md](setup/SKILL.md): the same install packaged as a Hermes agent skill.
- [CONTRIBUTING.md](CONTRIBUTING.md): build, test and release from source.

## Facts a tool needs

- Bridge: `127.0.0.1:8787`, loopback only, `GET /v1/health` returns `{"status":"ok"}`.
- Tailnet front door: `tailscale serve --https=8443` (real certificate; the apps refuse self-signed).
- Units: `hermey-bridge.service`; `hermey-gateway.service` only on hosts with no dashboard.
- CLI: `hermey status | pair | logs [n] | doctor | update | uninstall`.
- Requirements: Linux with systemd, Python 3.11+, Hermes installed, Tailscale (or your own TLS proxy).
- Apps: iOS 17+, macOS 14+, unsigned builds (AltStore/SideStore, or right-click → Open).
